ns2:section.sectionText: This course explores the current state of knowledge in the field of volcanology, and frontiers in volcano research. The format will be in-depth discussions of recent literature surrounding the question of how trans-crustal processes impact the eruption or storage of magma in volcanic systems. Each student will give presentations and short critiques of the assigned literature as well as develop and write a term project, research proposal, targeting an emergent question in the field. Grades based on presentations, written critiques, term project, and participation. Standard Letter Graded Class will meet in room 4041 NHB
